diagram_check.claim: An augmented characteristic strip evolves (X,Z) from the initial data (gamma(y), phi(y)); the spatial projection Psi(s,y)=X(s,y) is locally invertible at s=0 exactly when [a(gamma(y),phi(y)), D gamma(y)] has rank n.
concrete_maps_and_relations: Initial surface y -> (gamma(y), phi(y)) at s=0.
Flow parameter s maps (X,Z) by Xdot=a(X,Z), Zdot=b(X,Z).
Spatial projection Psi(s,y)=X(s,y) has initial derivative columns [a(gamma(y),phi(y)), D gamma(y)]; rank n is the transversality test.
diagram_check.editorial_scope: A schematic could clarify the distinction between the lifted (X,Z) strip and its spatial projection; no proof should rely on it.
